nac05.verdict: No env var or flag disables a rail. Setup-layer rails decide on no env var at all. The src-layer VITEST gates turn the src rails on when set; unsetting VITEST cannot remove the setup layer, and src/main.ts refuses a real start with VITEST set.

entries.name: VITEST
entries.where: src/config.ts, src/utils/notifier.ts, src/utils/db.ts, src/main.ts, scripts/pause.ts, scripts/preflight.ts, scripts/resume.ts, scripts/db-init.ts
entries.why: Set: the src rails are active (no .env load, Telegram refused, temp DB, tripwire on). Unset inside a test: the setup layer still installs in every worker and railed child and decides on no env var (selfcheck.cjs and dbTripwireSetup prove it with VITEST deleted). Unset in production is the normal path. Set on a real start: src/main.ts refuses before the lock (AUD-BUY-034, fixed).

entries.name: CSB_RAIL_RUN_ID
entries.why: Chooses a ledger location only, validated by RUN_ID_RE, captured once at first install. No rail reads it. An invalid value fails the install closed.

entries.name: CSB_RAIL_PROJECT
entries.why: Copied into ledger entries only. No rail reads it.

entries.name: ETH_FORK_RPC_URL
entries.why: Decides no enforcement: one of two values re-applied from the first shell capture in fork mode only. Absent means deleted, so the fork resolver errors. Full mode scrubs it.

entries.name: ALLOW_REAL_MAINNET
entries.why: Decides no enforcement in the rails. Absent means empty (gate closed). A protected-root .env cannot set it (childRails case iv).

entries.name: CSB_RAIL_* other, OS essentials, PATH
entries.why: inheritedEnv refuses these names. PATH is forced with the Node 22 folder first. NODE_OPTIONS is set last, so nothing can remove the preload.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option inheritedEnv
entries.role: plant literal app-key values in a child
entries.why: Refuses NODE_OPTIONS, PATH, VITEST, VITEST_*, CSB_RAIL_*, NODE_* and OS essentials. Values are test literals, never read from process.env; the child rails then scrub or keep them as a worker would.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option envOverrides
entries.why: Limited to test/.env.test app keys, re-validated in the child after the rails entry.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option homeOverride
entries.why: Refused unless absolute and under os.tmpdir().

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option nodeOptions
entries.why: Allow-list: --expose-gc, --preserve-symlinks, --preserve-symlinks-main, --no-warnings, --max-old-space-size, --stack-size. The rails preload is applied last and cannot be removed.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option ledgerRunId
entries.why: Pattern ^case-[a-z0-9-]+$; location only. dotenvSrcSkip test proves it does not affect enforcement.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option withVitestEnv
entries.why: Turns off only the src layer in that child, which is how the setup layer is proven to stand alone. The rails preload still runs.

entries.name: spawnRailedChild option railsEntry
entries.can_disable_a_rail: relaxes one rail for a test-code caller only
entries.why: Not an env var or flag, so not a bypass under NAC-05, but it does select fork mode for that child, where the general non-loopback deny is off. Used only by the two rail proof files. Registered as AUD-REAUDIT-004.

entries.name: raceHookForTests parameter
entries.role: swap the file between probe and open in a test
entries.why: A function parameter only production code never passes; no env var or flag can set it; it runs before the identity and version re-checks, so it cannot weaken them.

judgment_notes.vitest_main_process_covering_argument: Question (a). The Vitest main process is deliberately not railed. It holds, with its limits stated. What covers it is not the ledger, which only ever sees workers and railed children, but: no env-file loader in its import closure (test/unit/rails/forkShellOnly.test.ts scans both configs and the closure); Vite env loading off through envDir: false reaching every project through extends: true, proven against a fake .env for vitest.config.ts and, since a08d650, for the rehearsal config; the data folder compared by hash, size, mtime and listing before and after every run, which sees writes but not reads; and --net-watch sampling that includes the Vitest main process (vitest_main_observed true, 103 of 106 samples in ac19-run.json) and that can miss a very short connection, as the evidence_basis string in ac19-run.json itself says. So a verdict of untouched and a clean ledger do not prove the main process never opened .env; the argument is that nothing in its code path can, after the fix. AUD-REAUDIT-001 was the one place where that was false, and it was only for the rehearsal config. Note that the earlier checkpoint answer was re-derived here from the corrected facts rather than copied.
judgment_notes.db_probe_direct_read_fallback: Question (b). src/utils/dbPath.ts falls back to a direct read-only SQLite open when the temp copy fails with both -wal and -shm present. Acceptable for a live file: the direct open adds no write beyond what a SQLite reader does to -shm, it is only reached when both companions exist, and the read-write open that follows in openGuardedDb goes further anyway, then re-checks identity and user_version through the write handle before the caller can write. If -wal or -shm is missing it fails closed rather than create them beside the file. Under Vitest it cannot reach the live folder: the src tripwire and the setup-layer rails block it first. The single-instance lock also means no second bot process can be mid-write at boot; only preflight, pause and resume can run alongside a live bot, and a probe there is the case the temp copy exists for.
judgment_notes.spawn_site_allowlists: Question (c), assessed as rail options under NAC-05. ALLOWED_FILES: test/rails/spawnRailedChild.ts is the railed spawner; test/fork/setup.ts starts Hardhat with buildHardhatChildEnv, and hardhatChildEnv.test.ts's own AST check pins every child launch there; test/rails/selfcheck.cjs runs one unrailed child with its own literal code against a temp fake root only. COMPUTED_REQUIRE_FILES: test/rails/probes/duplicateLoadProbe.cjs only, limited to a plain require of a computed path; it runs only as a railed child. SAFE_EXEC_RECEIVERS: db, mockDb, fileDb, mem, w, attachRe, vacRe, entryRe are database or RegExp objects as used today; a receiver of those names could only hold a child_process object if a banned-module load had already got past the gate, and process.getBuiltinModule is the one route I found that the gate does not see (AUD-REAUDIT-003). No entry grants a route around the rails to a test that the rail itself would otherwise have stopped.
